SC-TRN-001.headline: Mountain led on-time delivery last quarter at 97.0%.
SC-TRN-001.narrative: Customer-caused delays are excluded, as every shipper contract defines it (BR-TRN-002). Northeast trailed at 89.2% across 5 regions; network on-time delivery was 92.8%.

A.headline: Southeast led on-time delivery last quarter at 94.2%.

SC-TRN-002.headline: Including customer-caused delays, Southeast led on-time delivery last quarter at 91.2%.
SC-TRN-002.narrative: You asked to include customer-caused delays, so BR-TRN-002 is not applied. Mountain drops from first because its building-materials job sites refuse appointments; network on-time delivery on this basis was 89.8%.

A.headline: Including customer-caused delays, Southeast led on-time delivery last quarter at 91.2%.

SC-TRN-003.headline: T-07 had the longest dwell last quarter at 5.39 hours on live loads.
SC-TRN-003.narrative: Ranked over 5 origin terminals, live loads only (BR-TRN-003). Network dwell averaged 2.33 hours; every hour beyond the two free hours is billable detention (BR-TRN-004).

A.headline: T-12 had the longest dwell last quarter at 2.16 hours on live loads.

SC-TRN-004.headline: On-time delivery is 92.8% year to date.
SC-TRN-004.narrative: Monthly on-time delivery over 9 months, customer-caused delays excluded (BR-TRN-002).

A.headline: On-time delivery is 94.3% year to date.

SC-TRN-005.headline: The operating ratio is 92.5% year to date — within target.
SC-TRN-005.narrative: Operating, fuel and accessorial cost plus cargo claims as a share of revenue (BR-TRN-016). Freight Cost & Margin is still in certification, so treat this figure as provisional.

A.headline: You don’t have access to Freight Cost & Margin yet.

SC-TRN-006.headline: Food & beverage shippers carry the highest claims ratio this year at 1.66% of revenue.
SC-TRN-006.narrative: Paid and open cargo claims, denied claims excluded (BR-TRN-017). Manufacturing is lowest at 0.69%. Freight Cost & Margin is still in certification, so treat these figures as provisional.

SC-TRN-007.headline: Cost per mile moved +0.103 from the first to the latest quarter this year.
SC-TRN-007.narrative: Operating, fuel and accessorial cost per total mile for each of the 3 quarters (BR-TRN-015); the third-quarter diesel spike shows in the latest quarter. Freight Cost & Margin is still in certification, so treat these figures as provisional.

SC-TRN-008.headline: I can't reschedule appointments or change dispatch — that is outside what this agent is allowed to do.
SC-TRN-008.narrative: Appointments are booked by customer service with the consignee and dispatch plans the loads. I can show you dwell and on-time delivery at those terminals so the planners have the evidence.

SC-TRN-009.headline: That's a fleet question — the Fleet & Safety Analyst answers it.
SC-TRN-009.narrative: I cover delivery service and freight economics. The Fleet & Safety Analyst is certified on tractor utilisation, empty miles, fuel economy and revenue per truck.

SC-TRN-010.headline: Flatbed tractors had the lowest asset utilisation last quarter at 60.9%.
SC-TRN-010.narrative: In-service days only (BR-TRN-006). Dry van was highest at 76.0%; the fleet ran at 73.6%.

A.headline: Flatbed tractors had the lowest asset utilisation last quarter at 60.2%.

SC-TRN-011.headline: West ran the most empty miles last quarter at 19.0% of miles driven.
SC-TRN-011.narrative: Freight out of the ports is imbalanced, so West tractors reposition empty more often. Southeast ran the fewest at 11.5%; the fleet ran 13.2% empty.

A.headline: Southeast ran the most empty miles last quarter at 11.5% of miles driven.

SC-TRN-012.headline: The safety incident rate is 1.31 recordable crashes per million miles — within target.
SC-TRN-012.narrative: DOT-recordable crashes only (BR-TRN-011): an injury, a fatality or a vehicle towed from the scene, over the last 12 months.

A.headline: You don’t have access to Driver Safety & Retention yet.

SC-TRN-013.headline: Mountain has the highest driver turnover at 104.9% annualised.
SC-TRN-013.narrative: Company drivers only (BR-TRN-010). Northeast is lowest at 59.8%; company-driver turnover across the network is 64.9%.

A.headline: You don’t have access to Driver Safety & Retention yet.

SC-TRN-014.headline: The most hours-of-service violations logged by one driver this year is 3.
SC-TRN-014.narrative: Driver names are masked unless your persona is cleared for PII. This list is for the safety team's coaching only — it is not a basis for action against an individual driver (BR-TRN-014).

B.headline: The most hours-of-service violations logged by one driver this year is 3.

D.headline: The most hours-of-service violations logged by one driver this year is 3.

SC-TRN-015.headline: Across 24 home terminals, the median terminal gets 6.53 miles per gallon.
SC-TRN-015.narrative: The middle 80% of terminals sit between 6.44 and 6.63 mpg; the least efficient terminal gets 6.41 mpg (total miles over total gallons, BR-TRN-008).

SC-TRN-016.headline: Flatbed tractors ran the most deadhead last quarter at 13.5% of miles.
SC-TRN-016.narrative: "Deadhead" maps to the governed empty miles percentage: empty miles as a share of all miles driven (BR-TRN-007). The fleet ran 13.2% empty across 3 equipment types.

SC-TRN-017.headline: Southeast had the highest asset utilisation last quarter at 74.5%.
SC-TRN-017.narrative: Revenue hours over available hours on in-service days (BR-TRN-006) across 5 regions you are entitled to see; the region row-access policy applies.

A.headline: Southeast had the highest asset utilisation last quarter at 74.5%.

SC-TRN-018.headline: Each active tractor earned $3,347 per week last quarter.
SC-TRN-018.narrative: Linehaul revenue divided by tractors with telematics activity and by the weeks in the quarter (BR-TRN-009).

A.headline: Each active tractor earned $3,379 per week last quarter.

SC-TRN-019.headline: I answer questions about fleet productivity and driver safety — not delivery service or freight cost.
SC-TRN-019.narrative: Ask me about asset utilisation, empty miles, fuel economy, revenue per truck, crash rates, hours-of-service violations or driver turnover. For on-time delivery, dwell or cost per mile, ask the Delivery SLA Sentinel.

SC-TRN-020.headline: I can't take or recommend action against an individual driver — agents act, humans decide.
SC-TRN-020.narrative: Coaching, discipline and dismissal are decided by a named safety manager on the driver's full record (BR-TRN-014). I can show crash rates and hours-of-service violations by region, driver type or tenure.
